Lower-branch dt=dx/[4xR²(F−c)]; with F−c=(c*−c)+Fʺ(x*)/2 (x−x*)²+..., dominated rescaling gives sharp coefficient and Cauchy measure, and upper-branch mass becomes negligible. Independent original-time angle quadrature at a=1,b=2 corroborates √(c*−c)T→π/[x*5^(1/4)]≈1.80077968. Source 1966 oval existence is not claimed as new.
